author: Mark Atwood
text:
Workspace-wide audit: pub struct MemoryBackend lacks #[non_exhaustive] in all 8 extension-server crates (mail/chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/sharing/metadata/filenode). One-line mechanical addition per crate; zero behavioral risk (single field is already private so external struct-literal construction is already blocked); pure convention-compliance per workspace AGENTS.md 'Conventions & Patterns'.

This is a workspace-wide canonical-template sweep — mail-server canonical first per the propagation rule, then propagate to the 7 siblings in lockstep. Could fold into JMAP-xbeb (workspace propagation epic for trait + handler + re-export contract sweep) as a fifth concern alongside .39/.40/.44 re-export/doc-contract issues; OR file as its own narrower workspace propagation epic.

Recommendation: fold into JMAP-xbeb. The class of work — workspace-canonical hygiene on the extension-server family — is the same; opening another epic would just create more bookkeeping. When JMAP-xbeb decomposes into per-crate children, this becomes a one-line addition under each sibling's child.

Filing deferred (not human) per workspace AGENTS.md 'When NOT to file human' rule 2 — this is parked-backlog awaiting JMAP-xbeb decomposition. The human-decision step (commit to workspace propagation) was already taken when JMAP-xbeb was filed.
